situation: A business buying copy paper for all its offices from one supplier.
complication: The contract ends next quarter, and today's price would overrun next year's budget.
key_question: How should the business source copy paper next year to stay within budget?

work.title: Request for quotes: recycled copy paper
work.for: Invited paper suppliers, email for the procurement manager to approve before sending
body: Hello, we are inviting a small number of suppliers to quote for our copy paper supply for next year.
We use about [F1] reams a year of standard office copy paper. We would like recycled paper, delivered to each of our offices: {list of office addresses to confirm}.
Please quote a price per ream, the recycled content of the paper, your delivery charges if any, and how quickly you deliver after an order.
Please also tell us your payment terms and whether your price is fixed for the year.
We will compare all quotes on the same basis. Please reply to this email with your quote and any questions by {reply-by date to confirm}.
